description: Use when the person says 'apply for me', 'apply to the best matches' or 'apply to this job' (pass job_id). Show them the jobs first. Start an application run: Keywordise takes up to `limit` of the matching jobs (same filters as list_matching_jobs, best fit first, never one already applied to), tailors the CV and cover letter for each, answers the employer's screening questions from the saved answers, and SUBMITS inside the employer's own system. Real applications leave in the person's name; needs a confirmed email and an active plan; counts against the plan. dry_run=true does everything except submit. Poll get_apply_run_status.

fresh.description: Freshness window; defaults to the account's saved filter.

job_id.description: Apply to exactly this ONE job (an id from list_matching_jobs) instead of a filtered batch — the same run, scoped to it. limit/match/fresh are ignored when set.

match.description: Match tier to draw from; defaults to the account's saved filter.

name: start_apply_run
title: Apply to my matching jobs
